name: offside_2v2_equal_numbers
description: 2v2, one car out of position on each team (blue car 0 upfield with blue car 1 covering; orange car 2 upfield with orange car 3 covering). Per the reward's own rules, equal numbers out of position pay nothing: team factor = clamp((1 - 1) / 1) = 0.

expect.intent: equal numbers out of position (1 v 1) pay nothing even though car 0 is 1000 uu upfield
car 0 is covered by a goalside teammate
the team factor is exactly 0 when both teams have one car out of position
